name: kernel-ltx-video
description: A video understanding benchmark intended to evaluate models on long-form / temporal video tasks — such as temporal localization, video question answering, and video captioning — requiring integration of visual and temporal information. It measures ability to reason about events over time and produce accurate retrievals, detections, or text outputs tied to video segments.
evaluation_method: Task-specific metrics (e.g., mAP / IoU for localization, accuracy for QA, BLEU/METEOR for captioning)
reputation: A specialized docs-benchmarks video dataset with limited but growing use in video understanding research; not yet a widely established standard.
